x: At the start of the race Sheffield received a serious blow in the disqualification of Proctor who joined in an extremely fast start with his team mates Allen and Hardy and our own Harry Churcher.
… in their triumph which they achieved after fighting hard for so many years; the splendid walking of the Sheffield boys Allen and Proctor, and finally, with greatest respect, the performance of T.…
The start saw L. Allen, Paddy Woods and our Bert Clayton with a disputed first place; Bert looked very comfortable and seemed quite willing to let the other two set the pace.
Albert Johnson who was with our Eric Hall at the halfway mark, walked a surprisingly fast second half to finish in front of Bob Goodall of Woodford. He was followed by Don Thompson, Met. and L.
